title: Rose geranium room spray
subtitle: A floral air freshener for bedrooms and sitting rooms
excerpt: A gentle floral spray of rose geranium and bergamot essential oils in a vodka-water base. Fresher and lighter than commercial floral sprays. Makes 150 ml.
sourceNotes: Rose geranium (Pelargonium roseum) essential oil properties and usage: EMA HMPC monograph on Pelargonium spp. (2012). Bergamot essential oil first-trimester caution: general aromatherapy reference. Alcohol dispersant in room sprays: standard cosmetic formulation.

recipe.batchNotes: Doubles to 300 ml in a larger bottle.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Mixes in minutes; store in the spray bottle.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Keeps six months. The floral note is strongest for the first three months. Discard if the liquid turns cloudy or smells sharp and unclean.

glossaryTerms.definition: Steam-distilled oil from Pelargonium roseum leaves. A softer, more affordable alternative to rose absolute with a warm rose-and-herb character. Used in beauty and fragrance products at 0.5 to 1%.

content.text: This is a light floral room spray for bedrooms and sitting rooms.

gives a warm rose-and-herb note that reads as a real floral without the heaviness of rose absolute. Bergamot adds a light citrus lift. The vodka disperses the oils and keeps the spray clear rather than oily.

items.prepNote: distilled for a clear, residue-free spray
lifts the rose note; avoid use near first trimester

content.text: Add the essential oils to the vodka in the spray bottle. Swirl to blend.
Add the distilled water. Fit the cap and shake.
Keeps six months in a sealed spray bottle. Shake before each use. The rose geranium note is strongest for the first three months.
